newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index climbs 1.53 percent.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index climbs 1.53 percent.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index rose 1.14 points, or 1.53 percent, to 75.82 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index rose 62.90 points to a provisional 3,427.87.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 14.14 percent after 14.08 percent on Wednesday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
